requirements.text: Students should be able to book study rooms easily, selecting dates and times while viewing available options in one place.
The system should allow students to manage book check-outs, returns, and renewals online, with reminders sent a few days before items are due.
Librarians need tools to view which books are checked out and track popular items.
The system should provide a way to manage fines and issues with books.
Notifications should be sent to students immediately when fines are incurred.
The system must be user-friendly and accessible on mobile devices.
